**Analyst:** Don Lopez  
**Date reviewed:** October 23, 2026  
**Platform shown:** Splunk Enterprise (operator reports a free trial; exact version not visible)

## Observed application results

A user-submitted screenshot of Splunk Search & Reporting displayed a green successful search, the **All time** picker and **Statistics (1)**. One result contained:

| Field | Screenshot observation | Expected |
| --- | --- | --- |
| timestamp | `2026-10-05T09:05:00Z` | Same |
| username | `smoke_user` | Same |
| source_ip | `192.0.2.99` | Same |
| host | `SYNTHETIC-SPLUNK-SMOKE` | Same |
| failure_count_in_window | `5` | Same |
| Result rows | **1** | **1** |

The visible SPL contains `makeresults`, `mvexpand`, UTC `strptime` and `streamstats` correlation consistent with the public seven-event query. The result is evidence of **a real Splunk user-interface execution of this small synthetic example**, not a mock API response.

## Evidence strength and limitations

The screenshot was reviewed in the conversation, but **has not been committed to this repository**. A visitor cannot independently inspect the original screenshot here. Splunk version/build, search job SID, authenticated export and host environment details have not been provided or independently verified.

This does **not** validate the complete 64-event matrix, file ingestion, all nine scenario families, SPL export parity, detection accuracy on real data, or a genuine security incident.
